properties.name: spring.mustache.check-template-location
properties.description: Whether to check that the templates location exists.

properties.name: spring.mustache.prefix
properties.description: Prefix to apply to template names.

properties.name: spring.mustache.reactive.media-types
properties.description: Media types supported by Mustache views.

properties.name: spring.mustache.request-context-attribute
properties.description: Name of the RequestContext attribute for all views.

properties.name: spring.mustache.servlet.allow-request-override
properties.description: Whether HttpServletRequest attributes are allowed to override (hide) controller generated model attributes of the same name.

properties.name: spring.mustache.servlet.allow-session-override
properties.description: Whether HttpSession attributes are allowed to override (hide) controller generated model attributes of the same name.

properties.name: spring.mustache.servlet.expose-request-attributes
properties.description: Whether all request attributes should be added to the model prior to merging with the template.

properties.name: spring.mustache.servlet.expose-session-attributes
properties.description: Whether all HttpSession attributes should be added to the model prior to merging with the template.

properties.name: spring.mustache.servlet.expose-spring-macro-helpers
properties.description: Whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library, under the name "springMacroRequestContext".

properties.name: spring.mustache.suffix
properties.description: Suffix to apply to template names.

properties.name: spring.mustache.view-names
properties.description: View names that can be resolved.

deprecation.reason: No longer required. To use Mustache without auto-configuration, depend directly on Mustache instead of spring-boot-mustache.
